Load libraries
```{r}
library(CellTFusion)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
source("src/utils.R")
set.seed(123)
```

Load data
```{r}
# Megaclusters data
entropy_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Spatial_cluster != "cDC1+") 
density_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/Table_mega_cluster_mm2.csv")

# Spatial data
load("../input/Spatial_densities.RData")

### Replace '+' with 'plus' to avoid mismatches and change to a numeric matrix
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- gsub("\\+", "_plus", colnames(x))
  x <- as.matrix(x)                     
  storage.mode(x) <- "numeric"       
  return(x)
})

counts = read.csv("../input/raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1) 
coldata = read.csv("../input/raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("N_Raw_matrice_Bulk")

counts = counts[,rownames(coldata)] #Order samples on counts based on clinical data

all.equal(rownames(coldata), colnames(counts)) #Verify samples from counts are in the correct order
```

Match samples with RNAseq
```{r}
# Entropy matrix
df_entropy = entropy_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Spatial_cluster, Value_entropy) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_cluster,
    values_from = Value_entropy
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 

# Density matrix
df_density = density_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Cluster_type, Nombre_cluster_type_mm2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster_type,
    values_from = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 

coldata = coldata[rownames(coldata)%in%rownames(df_entropy),]
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(coldata)]
df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(df_entropy) %in% colnames(counts),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density) %in% colnames(counts),]

df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(coldata),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(coldata),]

all.equal(rownames(df_entropy), colnames(counts))
all.equal(rownames(df_density), colnames(counts))

#Spatial data
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(df) {
  df <- df[rownames(df) %in% coldata$AN_clean, ]
  df = df[coldata$AN_clean,] #Order samples
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  df <- df %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Samples = rownames(coldata)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Samples")
  return(df)
})

all.equal(rownames(data_spatial[[1]]), rownames(coldata))
all.equal(rownames(data_spatial[[1]]), colnames(counts))
```

Normalize counts
```{r}
counts.TPM.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = F)
counts.norm.log = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

DCs-markers expression vs cell densities
```{r}
cDC1_markers = c("CLEC9A", "XCR1", "HDAC9", "S100B", "IDO1", "CADM1", "CLNK", "CPVL", "WDFY4", "C1orf54", "DNASE1L3", "CPNE3", "CCSER1")
cDC2_markers = c("CLEC10A", "CD1C", "FCER1A", "FCGR2B", "CD1E", "AREG", "GPAT3") 
mature_DC_markers =c("LAMP3", "BIRC3", "CCR7", "MARCKS", "MARCKSL1", "FSCN1")
pDC_markers = c("PACSIN1", "GZMB", "IRF4", "C12orf75", "LILRA4", "IL3RA", "CLEC4C", "SPIB", "IGKC", "IRF7", "JCHAIN", "PTGDS")

markers_expression_cDC1 = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%cDC1_markers,]
markers_expression_cDC2 = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%cDC2_markers,]
markers_expression_DC_markers = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%mature_DC_markers,]
markers_expression_pDC = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%pDC_markers,]

dc_subtypes = c("cDC1_plus", "cDC2_plus", "Mature_DC_plus", "pDC_plus")
markers_expression = list(markers_expression_cDC1, markers_expression_cDC2, markers_expression_DC_markers, markers_expression_pDC)

data_spatial = do.call(cbind, data_spatial)

for (j in 1:length(dc_subtypes)){
  spatial_data = data_spatial[,grep(dc_subtypes[j], colnames(data_spatial)), drop = F]
  CellTFusion::compute.modules.relationship(spatial_data, t(markers_expression[[j]]), file_name = dc_subtypes[j], width = 10, height = 7)
}
```

Gene signatures across patients using response information
```{r}
# Create gene set list
gene_sets <- list(
  Signature_cDC1_plus = c("CLNK", "XCR1", "WDFY4", "CLEC9A", "DNASE1L3"),
  Signature_cDC2_plus = c("CLEC10A", "CD1C", "FCER1A"),
  Signature_Mature_DC_plus = c("LAMP3", "BIRC3", "CCR7"),
  Signature_pDC_plus = c("CLEC4C",  "LILRA4", "PACSIN1", "SPIB")
)

dc_signatures_score = CellTFusion::compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, gene_sets = gene_sets)[[2]]
CellTFusion::compute.modules.relationship(dc_signatures_score, data_spatial[,grep(paste0(paste0("Total.", dc_subtypes), collapse = "|"), colnames(data_spatial)), drop = F], 
                             file_name = "DC_signatures-densities", width = 8, height = 7)
CellTFusion::compute.metada.association(dc_signatures_score, coldata[,"R.NR",drop=F], width = 8, height = 15, pval = 1)
```

Analysis across patient clusters
```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

Add patient groups obtained from megaclusters densities
```{r}
load("../output/Patients_groups.RData")
patient_groups = patient_groups[rownames(patient_groups)%in%coldata$AN,]
coldata = coldata[coldata$AN%in%rownames(patient_groups),]
patient_groups = patient_groups[coldata$AN,]
all.equal(rownames(patient_groups), coldata$AN)
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = factor(patient_groups$Groups))
```

Match patients in groups from spatial with RNAseq bulk 
```{r}
counts = counts[,colnames(counts)%in%rownames(coldata)]
df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(df_entropy)%in%rownames(coldata),]
df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density)%in%rownames(coldata),]
```

Normalize counts
```{r}
counts.TPM.norm = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = F)
counts.norm.log = ADImpute::NormalizeTPM(counts, log = T)
```

Deconvolution subgroups
```{r}
deconv = deconv[rownames(deconv)%in%rownames(coldata),]
deconv_subgroups = multideconv::compute.deconvolution.analysis(deconvolution = deconv, 
                                                               corr = 0.85, 
                                                               seed = 123, 
                                                               file_name = "Gobbini", 
                                                               cells_extra = c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3", "Plasma", "Tcells"),
                                                               return = TRUE) 
```

TF analysis
```{r}
tfs = compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log)
network = compute.WTCNA(tfs, corr_mod = 0.8, clustering.method = "ward.D2", return = T) 
```

Pathway analysis
```{r}
pathways = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log)
```

Chemokines scores
```{r}
chemokines = c("CCL1", "CCL11", "CCL13", "CCL16", "CCL17", "CCL19", "CCL2", "CCL20", "CCL21", "CCL22", "CCL23", "CCL24","CCL25", 
               "CCL26", "CCL27", "CCL4", "CCL7", "CCL8", "CX3CL1", "CXCL1","CXCL11", "CXCL12", "CXCL16", "CXCL3", "CXCL5", "CXCL6", 
               "PPBP", "XCL1", "XCL2", "ACKR4", "CCR1", "CCR10", "CCR2", "CCR3", "CCR4", "CCR6", "CCR7", "CCR8", "CCR9",
               "CMKLR1", "CXCR1", "CXCR3", "CXCR4", "CXCR6", "DARC", "XCR1")

geneset = list(chemokines)

chemokines_score = CellTFusion::compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, gene_sets = geneset)[[2]]
colnames(chemokines_score)[[1]] = "chemokines_score"

counts.norm.chemokines = counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%chemokines,]
CellTFusion::compute.modules.relationship(t(counts.norm.chemokines), df_entropy, "Entropy-Chemokines", width = 8, height = 15)
CellTFusion::compute.modules.relationship(t(counts.norm.chemokines), df_density, "Density-Chemokines", width = 8, height = 15)
```

Interferon genes
```{r}
# Type I interferons (alpha and beta)
IFN_I <- c(
  "IFNA1", "IFNA2", "IFNA4", "IFNA5", "IFNA6", "IFNA7", "IFNA8",
  "IFNA10", "IFNA13", "IFNA14", "IFNA16", "IFNA17", "IFNA21",
  "IFNB1"
)

# Type II interferon (gamma)
IFN_II <- c("IFNG")

# Type III interferons (lambda)
IFN_III <- c("IFNL1", "IFNL2", "IFNL3", "IFNL4")

CellTFusion::compute.metada.association(t(counts.norm.log[rownames(counts.norm.log)%in%c(IFN_I, IFN_II, IFN_III),]), coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 0.05)
```

Differential active TFs across patient groups
```{r}
coldata$group_1 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 1, 1, "rest"))
res_1 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_1, "1", "rest", file.name = "Diff_1vsrest")

coldata$group_2 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 2, 2, "rest"))
res_2 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_2, "2", "rest", file.name = "Diff_2vsrest")

coldata$group_4 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 4, 4, "rest"))
res_4 = diff_analysis(counts.norm.log, coldata$group_4, "4", "rest", file.name = "Diff_4vsrest")

gene_sets <- list(
  Group1_markers = res_1$TFs_UP,
  Group2_markers = res_2$TFs_UP,
  Group4_markers = res_4$TFs_UP
)
```

TFs signatures scores
```{r}
tfs = scale(compute.TFs.activity(counts.norm.log))
deg_signatures_score = compute.pathway.activity(t(tfs), gene_sets = gene_sets)[[2]]
patient_group <- apply(deg_signatures_score, 1, function(x) names(which.max(x)))
coldata$deg_group = patient_group
```

Survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.by.groups(coldata, "months")
```

Save genesets
```{r}
saveRDS(gene_sets, "../output/group_marker_genesets.rds")
```

Features evolution across megaclusters
```{r}
plot_features_weighted_across_clusters(df_density, deconv_cbsx_lm22, file_title = "CBSX_LM22 deconvolution across megaclusters density", filter_significant = F)
plot_features_weighted_across_clusters(df_entropy, deconv_cbsx_lm22, file_title = "CBSX_LM22 deconvolution across megaclusters entropy", filter_significant = F)

plot_features_weighted_across_clusters(df_density, chemokines_score, file_title = "GSVA Chemokines score across megaclusters density")
plot_features_weighted_across_clusters(df_entropy, chemokines_score, file_title = "GSVA Chemokines score across megaclusters entropy")

plot_features_weighted_across_clusters(df_density, t(counts.norm.chemokines), file_title = "Chemokines score across megaclusters density", filter_significant = TRUE)
plot_features_weighted_across_clusters(df_entropy, t(counts.norm.chemokines), file_title = "Chemokines score across megaclusters entropy", filter_significant = TRUE)
```

CellTFusion
```{r} 
cell_groups = construct_cell_groups(counts.norm.log, tfs, deconv, network, deconv_subgroups, coldata[,"Groups", drop = F], pval = 0.05)
```

Wilcoxon test of cell groups
```{r}
coldata_subset = coldata %>% dplyr::filter(Groups %in% c(2,4))
coldata_subset$Groups <- droplevels(coldata_subset$Groups)
cell_groups[[1]] = cell_groups[[1]][rownames(cell_groups[[1]])%in%rownames(coldata_subset),]
anova = cell.groups.anova.test(cell_groups, coldata_subset, "Groups", pval = 0.05)
```
